correctness.rationale: The positive weighted evaluation at π and 5π/7 cancels the free second and fifth harmonics and gives the exact upper bound. The proposed coefficients factor through (x+1)(x+cos(2π/7))^2 times a quadratic with positive leading coefficient and negative discriminant, proving global nonnegativity. Equality forces two contact zeros plus a derivative zero, a nonsingular three-equation system, proving uniqueness. Exact symbolic and rational checks are replayable in verify_exact.py.

value.rationale: Sparse Carathéodory–Fejér constants are natural invariants of prescribed Fourier support and feed directly into positive-definite point-value extremal problems. The support {1,2,5} is the smallest mixed-parity complementary pair beyond the first harmonic for which a nontrivial seventh-root two-contact certificate cancels both free higher harmonics. The result supplies an exact benchmark and a unique extremizer rather than a routine recomputation of the full-degree constant.
